captureMetadata.source: Generated report fixture, not real satellite RF
captureMetadata.preprocessing: Raw calibrated sample units preserved; saved model z-score only at inference.

capturePosition.globalSampleIndexSource: Recording sample index; no independent hardware counter supplied

baseline.description: Zero raw I/Q capture transformed by the same training z-score

limitations: Attributions describe this model relative to the chosen baseline; they do not establish physical causality or correctness.
Integrated Gradients uses finite trapezoidal integration; inspect the reported completeness residual.
Saliency is a local derivative in raw sample units; it is not an additive contribution map.

diagnostics.quantityDescription: Signed additive class-logit contributions relative to the recorded baseline.
diagnostics.regionRule: At most 16 highest-absolute-importance samples, joined only when contiguous. These are model-ranked regions, not detected RF packets or statistical significance.
